display_name: Phase1 身份保护 MixStyle：固定剩余两种子 E50 验证
description: 按首seed固定源条件PASS及先于target指标阅读的9e79dc413决策，剩余seed02/03四新scratch50、两历史基线；自动逐row clean/truthlast并与已完成firstseed合并三seed，不按目标改参数。
authorization: 用户持续Phase1特征84%目标；每模型≤50，旧门控cos，对话走不同路线，默认分类头联合训练、禁止单独头拟合；每探索实现和结果Git上传。

code.environment: ordinary N607 existing CVS-RFFI fullFP32; Torch/OMP/MKL/OpenBLAS2threads; local native verified Python

data.representation: raw/post_sync/noeq IQ2x256; original time/frequency/PA/reference/default head, NoExplicitCFO with internal compensation; only hidden-U ordering differs

roles.U_s: 56700 trueTX hidden; existing oldgate+EMA; read-only RX/day acceptance and predicted-class counts from existing forwards

data.capsule_id: existing VALIDATED_ONCE Phase1 clean capsule, unchanged physical IDs

permissions.claim_scope: Phase1 six old source TX clean/default-head DG research and fθ interface evidence only; exposed benchmark, no newTX/Phase2 or satellite claims; target fixed predictions then independent truth-last.

checkpoint.initialization: All6 new models scratch, no ancestor/checkpoint/teacher loading. Historical baseline3 reused only comparison and zeroIQ smoke; actual new EMA from own scratch model.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: New students/EMA own scratch no ancestors. Historical baseline all3 source roles EXACT_MATCH oldgate33+17 final50 independently verified; no baseline weight inheritance.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed final50 for every new row. Both first-seed final222 labeled CE<=.5 and PAIRED17epochs accepted U/963900>=.25 release remaining4 models. No V/target ranking, no inherited checkpoint.

execution.gpu_policy: max3 total experiment processes per GPU including all owners; >=12000MiB free; shared capacity lock
execution.stop_rule: Owned role/provenance/nonfinite/update budget/mainL hook/prediction/scoring technical failure stops new dispatch, preserves other healthy processes and artifacts; no automatic retry. All rows fixed50/11100; no target ranking, selection, early stop, seed replacement, parent selection or hyperparameter change.
